identity.name: Sahyog Partner Network
identity.tagline: Onboard NGOs and social enterprises as implementation partners for CSR programmes.
identity.description: Register your organisation as an implementation partner for funded social programmes. Due diligence covers legal registration, tax exemptions, CSR eligibility and financial track record, and typically completes in 2 to 3 weeks.

providerTypes.name: Implementation partner (NGO)
providerTypes.description: Trusts, societies and Section 8 companies delivering programmes on the ground.

providerTypes.name: Social enterprise
providerTypes.description: For-profit or hybrid enterprises delivering products or services with a social mission.

providerTypes.name: Training institute
providerTypes.description: Skilling and livelihood institutions running certified training programmes.

fields.label: Legal name of the organisation
fields.placeholder: As printed on your registration certificate

validation.patternMessage: PAN must be 10 characters, e.g. AAATS1234F.

fields.label: CSR-1 registration number
fields.helpText: Issued by the Ministry of Corporate Affairs. Required to receive CSR funds.

validation.patternMessage: Enter a valid CSR-1 number, e.g. CSR00012345.

fields.label: Authorised contact mobile
fields.helpText: We send onboarding updates to this number.

fields.label: People reached in the last financial year

documents.name: Registration certificate
documents.description: Trust deed, society registration certificate or certificate of incorporation.

documents.name: Organisation PAN card
documents.description: Scanned copy of the PAN card of the organisation.

documents.name: 12A and 80G certificates
documents.description: Current registration under sections 12A/12AB and 80G of the Income Tax Act.

documents.name: CSR-1 acknowledgement
documents.description: MCA acknowledgement showing your CSR-1 registration number.

documents.name: Audited financial statements (last 3 years)
documents.description: Balance sheet, income and expenditure account and auditor's report for each year.

documents.name: Latest annual report
documents.description: Programme outcomes, governance and board composition.

documents.name: Accreditation letter
documents.description: Affiliation or accreditation letter from the Sector Skill Council.

documents.name: Cancelled cheque
documents.description: For grant disbursement. Name must match the legal entity.

documents.name: Authorisation letter
documents.description: Board resolution or letter authorising the signatory on the organisation's letterhead.

stages.name: Draft
stages.description: Application is being prepared by the organisation.

stages.name: Submitted
stages.description: Received and queued for the partnerships team.

stages.name: Due diligence
stages.description: Registration, tax exemptions and financial statements are being checked.
requiredActions: Verify CSR-1 on the MCA portal

stages.name: Documents pending
stages.description: Additional or corrected documents were requested from the organisation.

stages.name: Site visit
stages.description: A programme officer visits a field location and meets the leadership team.

stages.name: Approved
stages.description: Organisation is an empanelled implementation partner.

stages.name: Rejected
stages.description: Application was not approved. The organisation may re-apply after 6 months.

consents.title: Partner code of conduct
consents.description: I accept the partner code of conduct, including the safeguarding, anti-fraud and conflict-of-interest policies.

consents.title: Registration verification
consents.description: I authorise the network to verify our PAN, CSR-1 and 12A/80G registrations with government records.

consents.title: Programme updates
consents.description: Send me updates about new funding calls, convenings and capacity-building sessions.

consents.title: Site visit data sharing
consents.description: I agree that photographs and notes from the site visit may be shared with prospective funders.
